name: Double Trouble's Blossom
source:
When you eventually return to Gardenville after moving 10 years ago, you are reunited with your [s]childhood crush[/s] I mean.. childhood friend.  Except, there's 2 of him??  Surprise, surprise, the boy you played with has a twin and unfortunately you're not quite sure which twin it is.  One twin is your childhood friend and the other is a very amused outsider in your story, will you find out which one is which?

[From [url=https://dhidhiand.itch.io/double-troubles-blossoming]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
搬离故乡10年之后，你终于重返花园镇，与昔日的[s]儿时暗恋对象[/s]……我是说，青梅竹马再度重逢。可问题是，他怎么突然变成了两个人？！惊喜吧，当年陪你一起玩耍的那个男孩居然有个双胞胎兄弟，而更糟的是，你压根分不清他们俩到底谁是谁。其中一个是你的青梅竹马，另一个则是躲在一旁看热闹不嫌事大的局外人——你究竟能否分清他们兄弟俩的身份？

[摘自[url=https://dhidhiand.itch.io/double-troubles-blossoming]itch.io[/url]]
